description: ISA-95 MaterialClass: a group of material definitions that share properties. Abstract: a domain profile (e.g. SMProfile-ThermoplasticClass) declares which properties its classes carry. A material definition (Article) is DEFINED_BY its class; a class may INCLUDE_PROPERTIES_OF a broader class.

attributes.name: material_class_id
attributes.description: Identity of the material class (e.g. PA66-GF30).

attributes.name: parent_class_ref
attributes.description: The broader class whose properties this class includes (INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF).

relationships.description: Class hierarchy (B2MML MaterialClass.MaterialClassBaseID): e.g. PA66-GF30 includes the properties of PA66.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 MaterialClass. The class carries the properties that are the same for every material of the class; the material definition (Article) carries what is specific to one material, the recipe (ProductDefinition) what is set on the machine.
